### ① Derived judgments

- `@object-ui/plugin-grid`: `ObjectGridComponentProps` gains optional `onRowGroupsChange(groups)`; its element type `ObjectGridRowGroup` (`key`, `label`, `rows`) is reachable through that prop on the published props type (not a named export of the entry). Additive: widening, correct.
- `@object-ui/plugin-kanban`: `ObjectKanban` gains the same optional prop; `KanbanLaneRows` is a new named type export from the barrel; `KanbanBoardProps.onLaneRowsChange` optional. Widening, correct.
- `@object-ui/plugin-list`: `onRowsChange(rows, groups?)` gains an optional second argument; `ListViewRowGroup` a new named type export. Existing one-argument handlers stay assignable (a parameter added at the end, optional): widening, correct. A paged ungrouped grid calls with one argument as before.
- `@object-ui/app-shell`: `RecordDrawerLevel.scope?` optional; `listShownRowsOf` / `listSiblingSetOf` are module exports of `objectViewRecordNavigation.ts`, not of the package entry. Widening, correct.
- No authoring key: every addition is a host channel, never metadata (the changeset says so).

### ② Semver level

`patch` on all four packages, `Metadata-protocol: none`: AGENTS.md Post-Task Checklist step 3 ("`none` takes **`patch`**; a non-protocol change, widening or breaking, ships `patch`"). Matches.

### ③ Boundary flags

The dev raised none. Seat-checked Acceptance readings: collapsed groups are not stepped (the order left it open; "shown rows only" is the reading the reader sees); a server-grouped group steps its page on screen; nested groups named by heading path.
